candidate_ledger.reversal_case: Elevated PCE inflation, weak breadth, and slowing payroll growth could sustain pressure on equities.
candidate_ledger.time_window_catalyst: Alphabet earnings on July 22 and scheduled labor-market releases on July 21.

A broad risk-off move overwhelms both sector-specific catalysts.

portfolio.invalidation_condition: Brent reverses below its July 20 level while the EIA report indicates a material inventory build or weaker demand.

portfolio_rationale: The portfolio concentrates on two independently supported, time-specific catalysts while respecting the 50% cluster cap. Communications has a major earnings event, and energy has both geopolitical supply support and an inventory release.
rationale_summary: Both selected exposures have base forecasts above SPY and identifiable catalysts before the exit close. Their distinct clusters reduce reliance on a single market driver.
